description: This source file defines the IncomingCallReceiver class, which extends BroadcastReceiver. It handles incoming SIP calls by processing intents, answering calls, and handing them over to WalkieTalkieActivity for further management.

classes.name: IncomingCallReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for incoming SIP calls and manages the call acceptance process.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Processes incoming SIP call intents, answers the call, and updates the associated activity.
